permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Talks to the Reins server (reins-jhyz.onrender.com), which relays your agents’ requests and reads the TON testnet.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: While a request is on your glasses, Reins listens for a few seconds for "approve", "reject" or "why". Audio is turned into text by the Reins server and not stored.
